title: Feature Request: torch.nn.DiagonalConv2d
bug_description:
### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch

I’d like to request a new convolution layer for PyTorch that performs diagonal convolution. This layer would convolve along the diagonals of the input tensor, rather than the standard vertical and horizontal directions.

The output shape will differ from standard 2D convolution. For example, a 4×4 input could produce a 1×7 output in each of the diagonal directions.

This operation could be useful for applications that require diagonal feature extraction, such as certain image processing or geometric transformations.

Ideally, the API would be similar to existing convolution layers (torch.nn.Conv2d) for consistency.
